_about: Scientific data library, domain atmosphere: the universal columns of the game's body/data/atmosphere.json tables, written by scripts/split_data.py. Same columns/rows schema as the game's tables. `id` is stable (see README); `source` holds source keys from sources.json ('; ' separated) or 'open'. Mark is the review state of these columns. A null in a column the engine's data/*.json holds by the same id means the engine file is the home of that value.

baseline.title: The baseline atmosphere (one world profile; every place inherits it)
baseline.source: Standard dry-air composition; sea-level pressure 101,325 Pa (760 mmHg); water vapour tracked apart because it follows temperature and humidity (ENVIRONMENT). ATM-STD
rows: fills the balance; matters only for diving (not in the game)
the one that keeps a body alive; inspired partial pressure is what the lungs see
nothing for play; folded into the remainder
accumulates in closed spaces; drives breathing
up to 47 at body temperature (the airways saturate inspired air)
takes room from oxygen in the alveoli; the 47 mmHg in the alveolar gas equation

altitude.title: Pressure with altitude (the standard atmosphere) and what the lungs see
altitude.source: Barometric formula P(h) = 101325 x (1 - 0.0065 h / 288.15)^5.256 for the lower atmosphere under standard conditions; oxygen stays 20.95% while total pressure falls; inspired PO2 = 0.2095 x (P - 47 mmHg). Alveolar gas equation PAO2 = FiO2 (Patm - 47) - PaCO2 / 0.8 (standard respiratory physiology; ATM-ALV). Caribbean use is small (the Blue Mountains 2,256 m); the table exists for the reusable engine.

modifiers.title: Local modifiers a place applies to the baseline (ENVIRONMENT supplies the inputs)
modifiers.source: ChatGPT's layer B (outside AI), kept; the ventilation numbers are placeholders from building-ventilation practice (air changes per hour).
rows: water vapour partial pressure; gas density (buoyancy)
ventilation of open and semi-open places; dispersal of a release (GAS_DYNAMICS)
the place's kind (ANATOMY of a ship: hold, orlop, cabin, gun deck; a room, a cave, a mine)
air changes per hour (ACH): how fast the volume is replaced by outside air
open deck infinite; gun deck with ports open 20; cabin with a window 5; hold with the hatch open 2; hold battened down 0.2; a cave 0.05; a room with a fire and a chimney 3
pressure +1 atm per 10 m; no air at all: the breathing medium changes (ANATOMY respiratory profile)
drowning is the lungs' medium, not a gas
a release lingers near the ground; smoke hangs on the water
dispersion x0.3 on a calm night

thresholds_layering.title: Exposure bands; consequences belong to medicine
thresholds_layering.source: Existing chemistry exposure bands retained; species susceptibility is anatomy data, medical stages are medicine data.
rows: under 19.5% work falls; species hypoxia tolerance: judgement and coordination; 12% unconscious; 6% death in minutes
